Plans and Pricing

Plans are billed monthly.

Pricing (Indian Rupee)

  • Mobile: ₹111/month
  • Basic: ₹222/month
  • Standard: ₹333/month
  • Premium: ₹444/month

Mobile

  • Ad-free movies, TV shows
  • 480p
  • Watch on one phone or tablet at a time

Basic

  • Ad-free
  • 720p
  • Watch on 1 supported device at a time

Standard

  • Ad-free
  • 1080p (Full HD)
  • Watch on 2 supported devices at a time
  • Download on 2 devices

Premium

  • Ad-free
  • 4K Ultra HD + HDR
  • Watch on 4 supported devices at a time
  • Download on 6 devices
